items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Jesse Hertz, sitting in the Apollo Theatre... So J.C. Jesse was sitting up in the balcony, box seats up there

ctx.x: Fast tempos, because I was always very concerned about my foot and bass drum. Left foot was all right, but that bass drum, playing fast, Tiger Rag tempos

and White Heat and all of that, oh, I was scared. Whenever you called a real fast number. Jo Jones and J.C. Heard Jesse Hertz, sitting in the Apollo Theatre, and I had an embarrassing scene when I was going on there, and all of a sudden, I'm trying to play one of those very fast tempos, because I was used to hearing that bass drum.
So J.C. Jesse was sitting up in the balcony, box seats up there, and I was (inaudible).
